Selected chronology: ^210Pb samples ending at 4.5 cm, both fallout markers,
and both radiocarbon dates. No explicit hiatus.

## Data and settings

```{r}
library(rplum)
library(rbacon)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

coredir <- "Plum_runs"
thick_cm <- 1
sample_depths <- c(seq(0.5, 24.5, by = 1), 25.25)
curve_depths <- seq(0.25, 25, by = 0.25)

dat <- read_excel("TRET25_rplum_simple.xlsx", sheet = "input")

pb_input <- dat |>
  filter(Type == "Pb210") |>
  arrange(Bottom_depth_cm) |>
  transmute(labID = Sample, depth = Bottom_depth_cm,
            density = Density_est_g_cm3,
            Pb210 = Total_Pb210_Bq_kg, error = Total_Pb210_error,
            thickness = Thickness_cm,
            supported = Supported_Pb210_Bq_kg,
            supported_error = Supported_Pb210_error)

c14_input <- dat |>
  filter(Type == "C14") |>
  transmute(labID = Sample, age = C14_age_BP, error = C14_error,
            depth = Mid_depth_cm, cc = 1)

fallout_input <- dat |>
  filter(grepl("^Fallout", Type)) |>
  transmute(labID = Sample, age = C14_age_BP, error = C14_error,
            depth = Mid_depth_cm, cc = 0)

age_at <- function(d) {
  ages <- Bacon.Age.d(d, set = info, BCAD = FALSE)
  ages <- ages[is.finite(ages)]
  data.frame(depth_cm = d,
             median_cal_yr_BP = median(ages),
             lower95_cal_yr_BP = unname(quantile(ages, 0.025)),
             upper95_cal_yr_BP = unname(quantile(ages, 0.975)))
}
```

## Fit final model

```{r}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 7
core <- "Age model Trettetjørn"
folder <- file.path(coredir, core)
dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pb_final <- pb_input |> filter(depth <= 4.5)
dates_final <- bind_rows(c14_input, fallout_input) |> arrange(depth)

write.csv(pb_final, file.path(folder, paste0(core, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
dates_file <- paste0(core, "_C14.csv")
write.csv(dates_final, file.path(folder, dates_file), row.names = FALSE)

# Open high-resolution PNG device
png(
  filename = "TRET25_PLUM_full_diagnostics.png",
  width = 4200,
  height = 2700,
  res = 300
)

# Original PLUM output, including diagnostic plots
Plum(
  core = core,
  coredir = coredir,
  otherdates = dates_file,
  date.sample = 2025,
  ra.case = 2,
  n.supp = 0,
  Bqkg = TRUE,
  cc1 = "IntCal20",
  BCAD = FALSE,
  thick = thick_cm,
  acc.mean = 30,
  d.min = 0,
  d.max = 25.25,
  d.by = 0.5,
  remember = FALSE,
  ask = FALSE,
  suggest = FALSE,
  plot.pdf = FALSE
)

# Close and save PNG
dev.off()

```

```{r}
library(rintcal)
cc <- ccurve(1)          # IntCal20: cal BP, 14C BP, error
yrs <- seq(min(cc[,1]), max(cc[,1]), by = 1)
mu  <- approx(cc[,1], cc[,2], yrs)$y
sig <- approx(cc[,1], cc[,3], yrs)$y

cal_one <- function(age, error, labID) {
  p  <- dnorm(age, mu, sqrt(error^2 + sig^2))
  cp <- cumsum(p) / sum(p)
  q  <- function(x) yrs[which(cp >= x)[1]]
  data.frame(labID, C14_age_BP = age, C14_error = error,
             median_cal_BP = q(0.5),
             lower95_cal_BP = q(0.025),
             upper95_cal_BP = q(0.975))
}

c14_cal <- do.call(rbind, Map(cal_one, c14_input$age, c14_input$error, c14_input$labID))
kable(c14_cal, digits = 0)
```
```{r}
#| label: acc-rates
acc_at <- function(d) {
  a <- accrate.depth(d, set = info)
  a <- a[is.finite(a)]
  if (length(a) == 0) return(data.frame(depth_cm = d, median_yr_cm = NA, lower95 = NA, upper95 = NA))
  data.frame(depth_cm = d,
             median_yr_cm = median(a),
             lower95 = unname(quantile(a, 0.025)),
             upper95 = unname(quantile(a, 0.975)))
}
acc_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sample_depths, acc_at))
kable(acc_tab, digits = 1)

# Plot of accumulation rate against depth (grey = uncertainty)
accrate.depth.ghost(set = info)
```
